lines.label: M6 x 25 socket head screw, ISO 4762

notes: Tighten every M6 to 2 N.m: HAND TOOLS ONLY, never a cordless driver. These bolts clamp printed PETG, not metal: at the bolt's own 10.4 N.m rating the head crushes the plastic under it and the joint fails silently, looking tight while holding nothing. Snug, then a nudge. Re-check the bolts after the first few weeks: PETG relaxes under load and the clamp will have eased.

events.text:
Small-parts organizer built from 7 hex cells in a flower cluster. All compartments are visible from above.

**Parts:**
- Central, -1,0 and 1,0 cells: half-depth bins with 3 compartments each (3×3 =9 compartments)
- 0,-1 and 0,1 cells: half-depth bins with 2 compartments each (2×2 =4 compartments)  
- -1,1 and 1,-1 cells: full-depth bins with 3 compartments each (2×3 =6 compartments)

Staged with example hardware (M3 screws/nuts/standoffs) to show use. Joints locked and perimeter capped.

Check_build: OK, meshClash clear, no prop warnings (PROP_BELOW_RIM props are low in bins but visible from above per look polar 10).
